d: MLC Election 2026 ki 8 siton (shikshak va snatak) ke aaye parinamon aur matganna ke rujhanon par bihar sarkar ke mantri evan bhajpa ke varishth neta do. dilip jayasval ki pahli bari pratikriya samne aaee hai. dilip jayasval ne dava kiya ki emaelsi chunav men endie ka pradarshan behad shandar raha hai aur bihar ki janta ne rajy sarkar ke vikas aur sushasan ke kam par apni muhar laga di hai. dilip jayasval ne rashtriy janta dal (RJD) aur kangres par tikha prahar karte hue kaha ki har ke bad baukhlae vipakshi dal apni nakami chhupane ke lie chunav aayog, dhandhli, prashasnik tantr ke durupyog…
